## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

SensorPermissionSystem — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/permission/SensorPermissionSystem.kt

## Trigger

SensorPermissionManager.onLaunch and SensorPermissionManager.requestAgain, called via the permission screen shown on first launch — observed

## Today

`SensorPermissionSystem` is an interface only, declaring `isGranted`,
`canShowSystemPrompt`, `requestPermission` and `openAppSettings`.
`SensorPermissionManager` depends on it and drives the permission
lifecycle correctly against it, but no class implements the interface
anywhere in `app-wear/src/main`; the only existing implementations are
in-memory fakes under `app-wear/src/test`, used solely by
`SensorPermissionManagerTest`, `SensorPermissionViewModelTest` and
`HomeViewModelTest`.

## Expected

A real implementation of `SensorPermissionSystem` wraps the
body-sensors runtime permission through the Android SDK:
`isGranted` reads the current grant state with
`ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission`, `canShowSystemPrompt` reads
`shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale` combined with whether the
permission has ever been requested, `requestPermission` launches
`ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission` and suspends until the
user resolves it, and `openAppSettings` opens an intent to the app's
permissions page in the system settings.
